description: This Java class 'ModuleTestData' provides a singleton utility for managing and tracking test data related to module lifecycle events in the OpenMRS system, such as context refresh, start, and stop calls. It maintains call counts and timestamps for each module identified by a moduleId.

classes.name: ModuleTestData
classes.description: Singleton class for storing and manipulating test data related to module lifecycle events in OpenMRS, including call counts and timestamps for various lifecycle methods per module.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ModuleTestData.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes all call count and timestamp maps for a specific module identified by moduleId.

methods.name: getWillRefreshContextCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the willRefreshContext method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: getContextRefreshedCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the contextRefreshed method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: getWillStartCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the willStart method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: getStartedCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the started method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: getWillStopCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the willStop method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: getStoppedCallCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the stopped method was called for the specified module.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Records the call time for willRefreshContext and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Records the call time for contextRefreshed and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Records the call time for willStart and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Records the call time for started and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Records the call time for willStop and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Records the call time for stopped and increments the call count for the given module.

methods.name: getWillRefreshContextCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last willRefreshContext call for the specified module.

methods.name: getContextRefreshedCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last contextRefreshed call for the specified module.

methods.name: getWillStartCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last willStart call for the specified module.

methods.name: getStartedCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last started call for the specified module.

methods.name: getWillStopCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last willStop call for the specified module.

methods.name: getStoppedCallTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last stopped call for the specified module.
